answer: The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The pulse assignment is published and haven records each panel. Shards are assigned from the canyon graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 710 identities would post 1551 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
